description: Delete a campaign for good. Works in every status except sending: a draft (the usual case, such as a duplicate), a scheduled one (removed, not returned to draft), and a sent, failed, paused or testing one. Deleting a paused or testing campaign drops everyone still pending and it can never be resumed, so confirm with the person first. Emails already sent stay in the email log, but the campaign's results and recipient list are no longer reachable. A campaign that is sending answers 409 invalid_state; delete it once it has finished or paused. Answers { id, deleted, recipients_discarded }.

id.description: The campaign's id from create_broadcast or list_broadcasts (a UUID), not its name

name: delete_broadcast
